sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully implements the required guarded applicability and load-case coverage logic with correct owners, paths, datatypes, and canonical namespace.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the applicability logic: the current top-level load-case constraints and sh:or require every targeted ship to be CP or FP and to carry cases 1-4, thereby turning applicability into an unsupported prohibition on other propeller types. Require exactly one xsd:string propellerType as branch-selection evidence, then place the coverage constraints behind guarded alternatives: non-CP/non-FP ships are out of scope and need no load cases; CP ships require cases 1-4; FP ships require an explicit boolean propellerReversingCapability, with false requiring cases 1-4 and true requiring cases 1-5. Keep missing propellerType, and missing reversing capability for FP, from passing.
Candidate faithfully implements the required guarded applicability and load-case coverage logic with correct owners, paths, datatypes, and canonical namespace.
